excluded_lemmas.tag: Qaamuus records a stem alternation (-gay, -gtay; -tegi), so generic concatenative generation is unsafe.

evidence.detail: CUN full Class-I paradigm, pp. 910, 921-922, explicitly supplies present, past, imperative and infinitive patterns across persons.

Reviewed Class-I signatures independently support qor (qoray, qortay, qori), xir (-ray, -rtay), and jab (-bay, -btay); reviewed corpus-backed 3pl forms qoreen, xireen and jabeen confirm the zero+een plural path.
